sanskrit: dyaur na ya i̍ndrā̱bhi bhūmā̱ryas ta̱sthau ra̱yiḥ śava̍sā pṛ̱tsu janā̍n | taṁ na̍ḥ sa̱hasra̍bharam urvarā̱sāṁ da̱ddhi sū̍no sahaso vṛtra̱tura̍m ||
english: Like the sky above the earth, the wealth of the noble one stands firm by his strength over peoples in battles. Him who bears a thousand loads for our fertile fields — grant him to us, O son of strength, the slayer of Vṛtra.

sanskrit: di̱vo na tubhya̱m anv i̍ndra sa̱trāsu̱rya̍ṁ de̱vebhi̍r dhāyi̱ viśva̍m | ahi̱ṁ yad vṛ̱tram a̱po va̍vri̱vāṁsa̱ṁ hann ṛ̍jīṣi̱n viṣṇu̍nā sacā̱naḥ ||
english: As the sky, O Indra, all sovereign lordship together with the gods was placed in you for all time; when you slew the serpent Vṛtra who had swallowed up the waters, O Ṛjīṣin, accompanied by Viṣṇu.

sanskrit: tūrva̱nn ojī̍yān ta̱vasa̱s tavī̍yān kṛ̱tabra̱hmendro̍ vṛ̱ddhama̍hāḥ | rājā̍bhava̱n madhu̍naḥ so̱myasya̱ viśvā̍sā̱ṁ yat pu̱rāṁ da̱rtnum āva̍t ||
english: Prevailing, mightier than the mighty, more powerful than the powerful, Indra to whom prayers have been made and whose greatness has grown — he became king over the sweet soma when he was ready to burst open all the strongholds.

sanskrit: śa̱tair a̍padran pa̱ṇaya̍ i̱ndrātra̱ daśo̍ṇaye ka̱vaye̱ 'rkasā̍tau | va̱dhaiḥ śuṣṇa̍syā̱śuṣa̍sya mā̱yāḥ pi̱tvo nāri̍recī̱t kiṁ ca̱na pra ||
english: There the Paṇis fled with their hundreds, O Indra, in the contest of song for the seer Daśoṇa; with his weapons he overcame the wiles of Śuṣṇa the non-nourishing one, and nothing of his treachery poured forth.

sanskrit: ma̱ho dru̱ho apa̍ vi̱śvāyu̍ dhāyi̱ vajra̍sya̱ yat pata̍ne̱ pādi̱ śuṣṇa̍ḥ | u̱ru ṣa sa̱ratha̱ṁ sāra̍thaye ka̱r indra̱ḥ kutsā̍ya̱ sūrya̍sya sā̱tau ||
english: Great treachery was banished for all time when at the fall of the thunderbolt Śuṣṇa was struck down; Indra made wide space on the same chariot for his charioteer Kutsa in the winning of the sun.

sanskrit: pra śye̱no na ma̍di̱ram a̱ṁśum a̍smai̱ śiro̍ dā̱sasya̱ namu̍cer mathā̱yan | prāva̱n namī̍ṁ sā̱pyaṁ sa̱santa̍m pṛ̱ṇag rā̱yā sam i̱ṣā saṁ sva̱sti ||
english: Like a falcon, crushing the intoxicating soma-shoot for him, twisting off the head of the Dāsa Namuci — he helped Namī the Sāpya while he slept, filling him with wealth, with refreshment, with well-being.

sanskrit: vi pipro̱r ahi̍māyasya dṛ̱ḻhāḥ puro̍ vajri̱ñ chava̍sā̱ na da̍rdaḥ | sudā̍ma̱n tad rekṇo̍ apramṛ̱ṣyam ṛ̱jiśva̍ne dā̱traṁ dā̱śuṣe̍ dāḥ ||
english: You shattered wide open with your power the firm strongholds of Pipru the serpent-sorcerer, O wielder of the thunderbolt; you gave to Ṛjiśvan, the devoted worshipper, O bountiful Indra, that imperishable inheritance as your gift.

sanskrit: sa ve̍ta̱suṁ daśa̍māya̱ṁ daśo̍ṇi̱ṁ tūtu̍ji̱m indra̍ḥ svabhi̱ṣṭisu̍mnaḥ | ā tugra̱ṁ śaśva̱d ibha̱ṁ dyota̍nāya mā̱tur na sī̱m upa̍ sṛjā i̱yadhyai̍ ||
english: Indra, whose own protection brings bliss, favored Vetasu, Daśamāya, Daśoṇa, and Tūtujī; he released Tugra's ever-enduring son to shine, like a mother releasing her son to seek his way.

sanskrit: sa ī̱ṁ spṛdho̍ vanate̱ apra̍tīto̱ bibhra̱d vajra̍ṁ vṛtra̱haṇa̱ṁ gabha̍stau | tiṣṭha̱d dharī̱ adhy aste̍va̱ garte̍ vaco̱yujā̍ vahata̱ indra̍m ṛ̱ṣvam ||
english: He wins the struggles, unimpeded, bearing the Vṛtra-slaying thunderbolt in his fist; as if seated in a chariot-box while his two bay horses stand hitched, those yoked by his word carry lofty Indra.

sanskrit: sa̱nema̱ te 'va̍sā̱ navya̍ indra̱ pra pū̱rava̍ḥ stavanta e̱nā ya̱jñaiḥ | sa̱pta yat pura̱ḥ śarma̱ śāra̍dī̱r dard dhan dāsī̍ḥpu̱rukutsā̍ya̱ śikṣa̍n ||
english: May we win with your aid, O fresh and young Indra; the descendants of Pūru praise you thus with sacrifices; when you crushed the seven autumnal strongholds for shelter, teaching them how, you gave the Dāsa women to Purukutsa.

sanskrit: tvaṁ vṛ̱dha i̍ndra pū̱rvyo bhū̍r variva̱syann u̱śane̍ kā̱vyāya̍ | parā̱ nava̍vāstvam anu̱deya̍m ma̱he pi̱tre da̍dātha̱ svaṁ napā̍tam ||
english: You were, O Indra, the first exalter, bestowing favor on Uśanas Kāvya; the new abode that was to be given up you gave to the great father, surrendering your own grandson.

sanskrit: tvaṁ dhuni̍r indra̱ dhuni̍matīr ṛ̱ṇor a̱paḥ sī̱rā na srava̍ntīḥ | pra yat sa̍mu̱dram ati̍ śūra̱ parṣi̍ pā̱rayā̍ tu̱rvaśa̱ṁ yadu̍ṁ sva̱sti ||
english: You, O Indra the roarer, set the roaring rivers in motion, the waters flowing like ploughshares; when you carried them safely beyond the ocean, O hero, safely convey Turvaśa and Yadu across.

sanskrit: tava̍ ha̱ tyad i̍ndra̱ viśva̍m ā̱jau sa̱sto dhunī̱cumu̍rī̱ yā ha̱ siṣva̍p | dī̱daya̱d it tubhya̱ṁ some̍bhiḥ su̱nvan da̱bhīti̍r i̱dhmabhṛ̍tiḥ pa̱kthy a̱rkaiḥ ||
english: That indeed was yours, O Indra, in the battle, all of it — Dhuni and Cumuṛī whom you put to sleep; for you Dabhīti, carrying fuel, pressing soma and singing hymns with cookings, shone forth.

sanskrit: i̱mā u̍ tvā puru̱tama̍sya kā̱ror havya̍ṁ vīra̱ havyā̍ havante | dhiyo̍ rathe̱ṣṭhām a̱jara̱ṁ navī̍yo ra̱yir vibhū̍tir īyate vaca̱syā ||
english: These offerings of one most devoted in worship, O hero, call you with things worthy to be called; thoughts that are worth mounting in a chariot, ever fresh and undecaying — may an abundant, far-spreading wealth come to us through speech.

sanskrit: tam u̍ stuṣa̱ indra̱ṁ yo vidā̍no̱ girvā̍hasaṁ gī̱rbhir ya̱jñavṛ̍ddham | yasya̱ diva̱m ati̍ ma̱hnā pṛ̍thi̱vyāḥ pu̍rumā̱yasya̍ riri̱ce ma̍hi̱tvam ||
english: Him I praise — Indra, who is knowing, who is carried by praises, who grows through sacrifice with hymns; whose greatness, full of many forms, surpasses that of heaven and earth.

sanskrit: sa it tamo̍ 'vayu̱naṁ ta̍ta̱nvat sūrye̍ṇa va̱yuna̍vac cakāra | ka̱dā te̱ martā̍ a̱mṛta̍sya̱ dhāmeya̍kṣanto̱ na mi̍nanti svadhāvaḥ ||
english: He spread out the darkness, the formless void, and made it luminous with the sun; when do mortals, seeking the station of the immortal, not injure it, self-sustaining as they are?

sanskrit: yas tā ca̱kāra̱ sa kuha̍ svi̱d indra̱ḥ kam ā jana̍ṁ carati̱ kāsu̍ vi̱kṣu | kas te̍ ya̱jño mana̍se̱ śaṁ varā̍ya̱ ko a̱rka i̍ndra kata̱maḥ sa hotā̍ ||
english: Where is that Indra who made these things? Among what people does he move? In which tribes? What sacrifice of yours is pleasing to his mind for choosing? What song of praise, O Indra? Which is he, the ritual priest?

sanskrit: i̱dā hi te̱ vevi̍ṣataḥ purā̱jāḥ pra̱tnāsa̍ ā̱suḥ pu̍rukṛ̱t sakhā̍yaḥ | ye ma̍dhya̱māsa̍ u̱ta nūta̍nāsa u̱tāva̱masya̍ puruhūta bodhi ||
english: Even those ancient ones born before thee, who acted much — your friends — they gladdened you with praises; those who are of the middle age, and those of recent times, and those of the very latest — be mindful of them, O much-invoked Indra.

sanskrit: tam pṛ̱cchanto 'va̍rāsa̱ḥ parā̍ṇi pra̱tnā ta̍ indra̱ śrutyānu̍ yemuḥ | arcā̍masi vīra brahmavāho̱ yād e̱va vi̱dma tāt tvā̍ ma̱hānta̍m ||
english: Seeking him, those of later days followed the ancient paths that are reputed to be yours, O Indra; we praise you, O hero who art carried by prayer, as great, by what alone we know of you.

sanskrit: a̱bhi tvā̱ pājo̍ ra̱kṣaso̱ vi ta̍sthe̱ mahi̍ jajñā̱nam a̱bhi tat su ti̍ṣṭha | tava̍ pra̱tnena̱ yujye̍na̱ sakhyā̱ vajre̍ṇa dhṛṣṇo̱ apa̱ tā nu̍dasva ||
english: The power of the Rākṣas has spread around you — the great one who was born; stand firm against that. With your ancient comradely bolt, O bold one, drive them away.

sanskrit: sa tu śru̍dhīndra̱ nūta̍nasya brahmaṇya̱to vī̍ra kārudhāyaḥ | tvaṁ hy ā̱piḥ pra̱divi̍ pitṝ̱ṇāṁ śaśva̍d ba̱bhūtha̍ su̱hava̱ eṣṭau̍ ||
english: Do hear this, O Indra, of the new devotee who loves prayer, O hero who gives to the singer; for you have ever been the ally from ancient times of the Fathers, easy to invoke in the quest.

sanskrit: protaye̱ varu̍ṇam mi̱tram indra̍m ma̱ruta̍ḥ kṛ̱ṣvāva̍se no a̱dya | pra pū̱ṣaṇa̱ṁ viṣṇu̍m a̱gnim pura̍ṁdhiṁ savi̱tāra̱m oṣa̍dhī̱ḥ parva̍tām̐ś ca ||
english: Invoke Varuṇa, Mitra, Indra, the Maruts — make them ready for our protection today; invoke Pūṣan, Viṣṇu, Agni the wise, Savitṛ, the herbs, and the mountains.

sanskrit: i̱ma u̍ tvā puruśāka prayajyo jari̱tāro̍ a̱bhy a̍rcanty a̱rkaiḥ | śru̱dhī hava̱m ā hu̍va̱to hu̍vā̱no na tvāvā̍m̐ a̱nyo a̍mṛta̱ tvad a̍sti ||
english: These singers, O much-aided Indra, worthy to be worshipped, honor you with hymns; hear the call of one who calls you, being called — no other than you, immortal one, exists like you.

sanskrit: nū ma̱ ā vāca̱m upa̍ yāhi vi̱dvān viśve̍bhiḥ sūno sahaso̱ yaja̍traiḥ | ye a̍gniji̱hvā ṛ̍ta̱sāpa̍ ā̱sur ye manu̍ṁ ca̱krur upa̍ra̱ṁ dasā̍ya ||
english: Come now to my speech, O knowing one, O son of strength, with all the adorable gods; those who are Agni-tongued, who gained the truth, who made Manu superior to the Dāsa.

sanskrit: sa no̍ bodhi purae̱tā su̱geṣū̱ta du̱rgeṣu̍ pathi̱kṛd vidā̍naḥ | ye aśra̍māsa u̱ravo̱ vahi̍ṣṭhā̱s tebhi̍r na indrā̱bhi va̍kṣi̱ vāja̍m ||
english: Be our pathfinder and guide over easy roads and difficult passes, knowing the way; with those wide, tireless, swiftest ones, O Indra, carry us toward the prize.

sanskrit: ya eka̱ id dhavya̍ś carṣaṇī̱nām indra̱ṁ taṁ gī̱rbhir a̱bhy a̍rca ā̱bhiḥ | yaḥ patya̍te vṛṣa̱bho vṛṣṇyā̍vān sa̱tyaḥ satvā̍ purumā̱yaḥ saha̍svān ||
english: He who alone among all peoples is to be invoked — Indra — honor him with these hymns; he who rules as the bull full of virile power, the true one, the warrior of many forms, the powerful.

sanskrit: tam u̍ na̱ḥ pūrve̍ pi̱taro̱ nava̍gvāḥ sa̱pta viprā̍so a̱bhi vā̱jaya̍ntaḥ | na̱kṣa̱ddā̱bhaṁ tatu̍rim parvate̱ṣṭhām adro̍ghavācam ma̱tibhi̱ḥ śavi̍ṣṭham ||
english: Him too our ancient fathers, the nine-fold ones, the seven seers, winning the prize, the most powerful one — unerring, quick, abiding on the mountain, truthful in speech — they praised with their prayers.

sanskrit: tam ī̍maha̱ indra̍m asya rā̱yaḥ pu̍ru̱vīra̍sya nṛ̱vata̍ḥ puru̱kṣoḥ | yo askṛ̍dhoyur a̱jara̱ḥ sva̍rvā̱n tam ā bha̍ra harivo māda̱yadhyai̍ ||
english: We seek from Indra this wealth abounding in heroes, attended by men, and rich in abundance; he who is ever joyful, ageless, possessing heaven — bring him here, O bay-horsed lord, to exhilarate us.

sanskrit: tan no̱ vi vo̍co̱ yadi̍ te pu̱rā ci̍j jari̱tāra̍ āna̱śuḥ su̱mnam i̍ndra | kas te̍ bhā̱gaḥ kiṁ vayo̍ dudhra khidva̱ḥ puru̍hūta purūvaso 'sura̱ghnaḥ ||
english: Declare that to us — whether your lauders from of old have obtained your favor, O Indra; what is your share, what the drink, O harasser of the obdurate, much-invoked, most wealthy, slayer of Asuras?

sanskrit: tam pṛ̱cchantī̱ vajra̍hastaṁ rathe̱ṣṭhām indra̱ṁ vepī̱ vakva̍rī̱ yasya̱ nū gīḥ | tu̱vi̱grā̱bhaṁ tu̍vikū̱rmiṁ ra̍bho̱dāṁ gā̱tum i̍ṣe̱ nakṣa̍te̱ tumra̱m accha̍ ||
english: Seeking him, the trembling, babbling worshipper whose hymn this now is — Indra standing in his chariot, thunderbolt in hand — grasping mightily, acting mightily, giving swiftly, she moves along a path, going toward the resounding one.

sanskrit: a̱yā ha̱ tyam mā̱yayā̍ vāvṛdhā̱nam ma̍no̱juvā̍ svatava̱ḥ parva̍tena | acyu̍tā cid vīḻi̱tā svo̍jo ru̱jo vi dṛ̱ḻhā dhṛ̍ṣa̱tā vi̍rapśin ||
english: With this very magic power, self-strong Indra, who has grown great, waxed strong with a mountain swift as thought — even firm, fortified strongholds with your own strength you shatter and break down the solid ones, O mighty one.

sanskrit: taṁ vo̍ dhi̱yā navya̍syā̱ śavi̍ṣṭham pra̱tnam pra̍tna̱vat pa̍ritaṁsa̱yadhyai̍ | sa no̍ vakṣad animā̱naḥ su̱vahmendro̱ viśvā̱ny ati̍ du̱rgahā̍ṇi ||
english: Him, the most powerful, I wish to honor with a new prayer, the ancient one, as with an ancient hymn; may he, Indra, effortless and well-loaded, carry us beyond all difficult passages.

sanskrit: ā janā̍ya̱ druhva̍ṇe̱ pārthi̍vāni di̱vyāni̍ dīpayo̱ 'ntari̍kṣā | tapā̍ vṛṣan vi̱śvata̍ḥ śo̱ciṣā̱ tān bra̍hma̱dviṣe̍ śocaya̱ kṣām a̱paś ca̍ ||
english: Blaze out the earthly and the heavenly and the atmospheric regions for the hostile people; burn them, O bull, with your flame on all sides — for the enemy of prayer, burn up earth and the waters.

sanskrit: bhuvo̱ jana̍sya di̱vyasya̱ rājā̱ pārthi̍vasya̱ jaga̍tas tveṣasaṁdṛk | dhi̱ṣva vajra̱ṁ dakṣi̍ṇa indra̱ haste̱ viśvā̍ ajurya dayase̱ vi mā̱yāḥ ||
english: You became king of the divine and earthly peoples, of the moving world, splendid in appearance; grasp the thunderbolt in your right hand, O Indra — ageless one, you apportion all magic powers.

sanskrit: ā sa̱ṁyata̍m indra ṇaḥ sva̱stiṁ śa̍tru̱tūryā̍ya bṛha̱tīm amṛ̍dhrām | yayā̱ dāsā̱ny āryā̍ṇi vṛ̱trā karo̍ vajrin su̱tukā̱ nāhu̍ṣāṇi ||
english: Bring for us, O Indra, as it were concentrated, great, unimpeded well-being for victory over our enemies; with it, O thunderer, make swift dispatch of both Dāsa and Ārya foes, and those of Nahuṣa.

sanskrit: sa no̍ ni̱yudbhi̍ḥ puruhūta vedho vi̱śvavā̍rābhi̱r ā ga̍hi prayajyo | na yā ade̍vo̱ vara̍te̱ na de̱va ābhi̍r yāhi̱ tūya̱m ā ma̍drya̱drik ||
english: Come to us with your teams, O much-invoked and wise Indra, worthy of worship, with all your treasures; come swiftly with those which neither a non-god restrains nor a god, to give us gladness.

sanskrit: su̱ta it tvaṁ nimi̍śla indra̱ some̱ stome̱ brahma̍ṇi śa̱syamā̍na u̱kthe | yad vā̍ yu̱ktābhyā̍m maghava̱n hari̍bhyā̱m bibhra̱d vajra̍m bā̱hvor i̍ndra̱ yāsi̍ ||
english: You are truly present, O Indra, in the pressed soma, in the hymn of praise, in the recitation of prayer; or when, O Maghavan, bearing the thunderbolt in your arms, you travel with your two yoked bay horses.

sanskrit: yad vā̍ di̱vi pārye̱ suṣvi̍m indra vṛtra̱hatye 'va̍si̱ śūra̍sātau | yad vā̱ dakṣa̍sya bi̱bhyuṣo̱ abi̍bhya̱d ara̍ndhaya̱ḥ śardha̍ta indra̱ dasyū̍n ||
english: Or when, at the appointed time in heaven, O Indra, you protect the soma-presser in the hero-winning battle against Vṛtra; or when, fearless, you subdued the fearful Dasyus for the zealous worshipper.

sanskrit: pātā̍ su̱tam indro̍ astu̱ soma̍m praṇe̱nīr u̱gro ja̍ri̱tāra̍m ū̱tī | kartā̍ vī̱rāya̱ suṣva̍ya u lo̱kaṁ dātā̱ vasu̍ stuva̱te kī̱raye̍ cit ||
english: May Indra drink the pressed soma, may the fierce one be the guide, the protector of the singer; may he make space for the hero among the good soma-pressers, may he give wealth to one who praises and to one who only recites.

sanskrit: ganteyā̍nti̱ sava̍nā̱ hari̍bhyām ba̱bhrir vajra̍m pa̱piḥ soma̍ṁ da̱dir gāḥ | kartā̍ vī̱raṁ narya̱ṁ sarva̍vīra̱ṁ śrotā̱ hava̍ṁ gṛṇa̱taḥ stoma̍vāhāḥ ||
english: May he come with his bay horses to the soma-pressings; the tawny one who bears the bolt, who drinks the soma, who gives the cows — may he create the hero, manly and complete in heroism; he who carries hymns of praise will hear the call of the singer.

sanskrit: asmai̍ va̱yaṁ yad vā̱vāna̱ tad vi̍viṣma̱ indrā̍ya̱ yo na̍ḥ pra̱divo̱ apa̱s kaḥ | su̱te some̍ stu̱masi̱ śaṁsa̍d u̱kthendrā̍ya̱ brahma̱ vardha̍na̱ṁ yathāsa̍t ||
english: To him we would offer what he desires — to Indra who has performed works for us from ancient times; with the soma pressed we praise him; may the spoken prayer and the brahman be growth-giving to Indra.

sanskrit: brahmā̍ṇi̱ hi ca̍kṛ̱ṣe vardha̍nāni̱ tāva̍t ta indra ma̱tibhi̍r viviṣmaḥ | su̱te some̍ sutapā̱ḥ śaṁta̍māni̱ rāṇḍyā̍ kriyāsma̱ vakṣa̍ṇāni ya̱jñaiḥ ||
english: For you have indeed made prayers to be growth-giving — so much do we serve you, O Indra, with devotions; at the pressing of soma, O drinker of pressed juice, may we perform the most blissful libations with sacrifices that are meant for you.

sanskrit: sa no̍ bodhi puro̱ḻāśa̱ṁ rarā̍ṇa̱ḥ pibā̱ tu soma̱ṁ goṛ̍jīkam indra | edam ba̱rhir yaja̍mānasya sīdo̱ruṁ kṛ̍dhi tvāya̱ta u̍ lo̱kam ||
english: Take heed of us, O Indra, delighting, granting the sacrificial cake; do drink the soma mingled with curds and milk; sit on this sacrificial grass of the worshipper, and make wide the space for one who is devoted to you.

sanskrit: sa ma̍ndasvā̱ hy anu̱ joṣa̍m ugra̱ pra tvā̍ ya̱jñāsa̍ i̱me a̍śnuvantu | preme havā̍saḥ puruhū̱tam a̱sme ā tve̱yaṁ dhīr ava̍sa indra yamyāḥ ||
english: Be gladdened at will, O fierce one; may these sacrifices find favor with you; the libation-calls that invoke you much — may they reach us; may this thought, inclined toward you, O Indra, be worthy of protection.

sanskrit: taṁ va̍ḥ sakhāya̱ḥ saṁ yathā̍ su̱teṣu̱ some̍bhir īm pṛṇatā bho̱jam indra̍m | ku̱vit tasmā̱ asa̍ti no̱ bharā̍ya̱ na suṣvi̱m indro 'va̍se mṛdhāti ||
english: O friends, satisfy Indra who enjoys himself, with the soma pressings, as is fitting; will he who is like that for our nourishment — will Indra scorn the good soma-presser when it comes to protection?

sanskrit: e̱ved indra̍ḥ su̱te a̍stāvi̱ some̍ bha̱radvā̍jeṣu̱ kṣaya̱d in ma̱ghona̍ḥ | asa̱d yathā̍ jari̱tra u̱ta sū̱rir indro̍ rā̱yo vi̱śvavā̍rasya dā̱tā ||
english: Thus Indra was praised at the pressing of soma among the Bharadvājas, where Maghavan abides; may Indra be such a giver of all-precious wealth to both the praising singer and the patron.

sanskrit: vṛṣā̱ mada̱ indre̱ śloka̍ u̱kthā sacā̱ some̍ṣu suta̱pā ṛ̍jī̱ṣī | a̱rca̱tryo̍ ma̱ghavā̱ nṛbhya̍ u̱kthair dyu̱kṣo rājā̍ gi̱rām akṣi̍totiḥ ||
english: The bull's exhilaration is in Indra — songs of fame and hymns together at soma-pressings, he who drinks the pressed juice and wins the prize; Maghavan who is to be praised by heroes with hymns, king dwelling in the bright sky, the unfailing helper of praises.

sanskrit: tatu̍rir vī̱ro naryo̱ vice̍tā̱ḥ śrotā̱ hava̍ṁ gṛṇa̱ta u̱rvyū̍tiḥ | vasu̱ḥ śaṁso̍ na̱rāṁ kā̱rudhā̍yā vā̱jī stu̱to vi̱dathe̍ dāti̱ vāja̍m ||
english: The swift hero, manly and discerning, the hearer of the call of the singer, whose protection is broad; the treasure, the one praised by men, who nourishes the singer — when praised in the assembly, the prize-winner gives the prize.

sanskrit: akṣo̱ na ca̱kryo̍ḥ śūra bṛ̱han pra te̍ ma̱hnā ri̍rice̱ roda̍syoḥ | vṛ̱kṣasya̱ nu te̍ puruhūta va̱yā vy ū̱tayo̍ ruruhur indra pū̱rvīḥ ||
english: Like an axle between the two wheels, O hero, your greatness has surpassed the two worlds; like the branches of a tree, O much-invoked Indra, your many aids have spread upward.

sanskrit: śacī̍vatas te puruśāka̱ śākā̱ gavā̍m iva sru̱taya̍ḥ sa̱ṁcara̍ṇīḥ | va̱tsānā̱ṁ na ta̱ntaya̍s ta indra̱ dāma̍nvanto adā̱māna̍ḥ sudāman ||
english: Your mighty powers, O much-aided Indra, flow like streams from cows, easy to traverse; like the tethers of calves — your bonds that bind and do not bind, O bountiful giver.

sanskrit: a̱nyad a̱dya karva̍ram a̱nyad u̱ śvo 'sa̍c ca̱ san muhu̍r āca̱krir indra̍ḥ | mi̱tro no̱ atra̱ varu̍ṇaś ca pū̱ṣāryo vaśa̍sya parye̱tāsti̍ ||
english: Something cunning today and something else again tomorrow — ever both real and unreal does Indra perform suddenly; Mitra is here as our ally, and Varuṇa and Pūṣan, and the noble one who goes round about as our benefactor.

sanskrit: vi tvad āpo̱ na parva̍tasya pṛ̱ṣṭhād u̱kthebhi̍r indrānayanta ya̱jñaiḥ | taṁ tvā̱bhiḥ su̍ṣṭu̱tibhi̍r vā̱jaya̍nta ā̱jiṁ na ja̍gmur girvāho̱ aśvā̍ḥ ||
english: Like waters from the back of a mountain, they brought you forth, O Indra, with hymns and sacrifices; those who are carried by praises, spurring you on with these good praises, came to you like horses to a race.

sanskrit: na yaṁ jara̍nti śa̱rado̱ na māsā̱ na dyāva̍ indra̱m avaka̱rśaya̍nti | vṛ̱ddhasya̍ cid vardhatām asya ta̱nūḥ stome̍bhir u̱kthaiś ca̍ śa̱syamā̍nā ||
english: Autumns do not age Indra, nor do months, nor do days diminish him; may the body of this great one, even as he grows old, continue to grow, being celebrated with hymns and recitations.

sanskrit: na vī̱ḻave̱ nama̍te̱ na sthi̱rāya̱ na śardha̍te̱ dasyu̍jūtāya sta̱vān | ajrā̱ indra̍sya gi̱raya̍ś cid ṛ̱ṣvā ga̍mbhī̱re ci̍d bhavati gā̱dham a̍smai ||
english: The hymn does not bow to the firm and mighty, nor to the Dasyu-driven warrior; even the lofty mountains become plains before Indra, and even in the deep there is a ford for him.

sanskrit: ga̱mbhī̱reṇa̍ na u̱ruṇā̍matri̱n preṣo ya̍ndhi sutapāva̱n vājā̍n | sthā ū̱ ṣu ū̱rdhva ū̱tī ari̍ṣaṇyann a̱ktor vyu̍ṣṭau̱ pari̍takmyāyām ||
english: O all-consumer, with your broad deep one send us drives of prizes, O drinker of pressed juice; stand upright in your protection without causing harm at dawn's break, in the circling course.

sanskrit: saca̍sva nā̱yam ava̍se a̱bhīka̍ i̱to vā̱ tam i̍ndra pāhi ri̱ṣaḥ | a̱mā cai̍na̱m ara̍ṇye pāhi ri̱ṣo made̍ma śa̱tahi̍māḥ su̱vīrā̍ḥ ||
english: Be with this fearless one for protection, O Indra, or from here protect him from harm; protect him from harm at home and in the forest — may we rejoice through a hundred winters with good heroes.

sanskrit: yā ta̍ ū̱tir a̍va̱mā yā pa̍ra̱mā yā ma̍dhya̱mendra̍ śuṣmi̱nn asti̍ | tābhi̍r ū̱ ṣu vṛ̍tra̱hatye̍ 'vīr na e̱bhiś ca̱ vājai̍r ma̱hān na̍ ugra ||
english: Your aid that is nearest, your aid that is farthest, and that which is in between, O Indra the mighty — with all of these protect us in the Vṛtra-slaying, and with these prizes, O great and fierce one.

sanskrit: ābhi̱ḥ spṛdho̍ mitha̱tīr ari̍ṣaṇyann a̱mitra̍sya vyathayā ma̱nyum i̍ndra | ābhi̱r viśvā̍ abhi̱yujo̱ viṣū̍cī̱r āryā̍ya̱ viśo 'va̍ tārī̱r dāsī̍ḥ ||
english: With these, keep us unharmed in mutual conflicts and battles, O Indra, disrupting the fury of the enemy; with these, carrying off all attackers in every direction, rescue the Ārya peoples from the Dāsa.

sanskrit: indra̍ jā̱maya̍ u̱ta ye 'jā̍mayo 'rvācī̱nāso̍ va̱nuṣo̍ yuyu̱jre | tvam e̍ṣāṁ vithu̱rā śavā̍ṁsi ja̱hi vṛṣṇyā̍ni kṛṇu̱hī parā̍caḥ ||
english: O Indra, those who are kinsmen and those who are not kinsmen, the greedy ones who have been yoked as adversaries — shatter their unstable powers, make their virile forces turn away.

sanskrit: śūro̍ vā̱ śūra̍ṁ vanate̱ śarī̍rais tanū̱rucā̱ taru̍ṣi̱ yat kṛ̱ṇvaite̍ | to̱ke vā̱ goṣu̱ tana̍ye̱ yad a̱psu vi kranda̍sī u̱rvarā̍su̱ bravai̍te ||
english: When hero wins hero with bodies, striving in glory of person, they contend; or when they cry out in two roaring voices over offspring or cattle or children or water or ploughed fields.

sanskrit: na̱hi tvā̱ śūro̱ na tu̱ro na dhṛ̱ṣṇur na tvā̍ yo̱dho manya̍māno yu̱yodha̍ | indra̱ naki̍ṣ ṭvā̱ praty a̍sty eṣā̱ṁ viśvā̍ jā̱tāny a̱bhy a̍si̱ tāni̍ ||
english: No hero, no swift one, no bold fighter, no warrior who thinks himself such has fought against you; O Indra, none of these can stand against you — all things born, you surpass them all.

sanskrit: sa pa̍tyata u̱bhayo̍r nṛ̱mṇam a̱yor yadī̍ ve̱dhasa̍ḥ sami̱the hava̍nte | vṛ̱tre vā̍ ma̱ho nṛ̱vati̱ kṣaye̍ vā̱ vyaca̍svantā̱ yadi̍ vitanta̱saite̍ ||
english: He reigns over the manly power of both sides, when the worshippers call each other at the meeting; or in the great Vṛtra, or in a dwelling with men — when the two wide-reaching ones stretch out.

sanskrit: adha̍ smā te carṣa̱ṇayo̱ yad ejā̱n indra̍ trā̱tota bha̍vā varū̱tā | a̱smākā̍so̱ ye nṛta̍māso a̱rya indra̍ sū̱rayo̍ dadhi̱re pu̱ro na̍ḥ ||
english: So when the peoples are in motion, O Indra, be both deliverer and protector; those who are most manly among the Āryas who are ours, O Indra — the patrons have placed them at our fore.

sanskrit: anu̍ te dāyi ma̱ha i̍ndri̱yāya̍ sa̱trā te̱ viśva̱m anu̍ vṛtra̱hatye̍ | anu̍ kṣa̱tram anu̱ saho̍ yaja̱trendra̍ de̱vebhi̱r anu̍ te nṛ̱ṣahye̍ ||
english: For your great might it was given, O Indra; all this entire world is yours for the slaying of Vṛtra; yours is the ruling power, yours the strength, O adorable Indra — yours the virile conquest along with the gods.

sanskrit: e̱vā na̱ḥ spṛdha̱ḥ sam a̍jā sa̱matsv indra̍ rāra̱ndhi mi̍tha̱tīr ade̍vīḥ ||vi̱dyāma̱ vasto̱r ava̍sā gṛ̱ṇanto̍ bha̱radvā̍jā u̱ta ta̍ indra nū̱nam ||
english: Thus drive together our rivals in battles, O Indra — subdue the godless combatants; may we Bharadvājas know your protection while singing, O Indra, both today and now.

sanskrit: śru̱dhī na̍ indra̱ hvayā̍masi tvā ma̱ho vāja̍sya sā̱tau vā̍vṛṣā̱ṇāḥ | saṁ yad viśo 'ya̍nta̱ śūra̍sātā u̱graṁ no 'va̱ḥ pārye̍ aha̍n dāḥ ||
english: Hear us, O Indra, we call you, striving for the great prize; when the peoples came together for the winning of heroes, give us your fierce protection on the appointed day.

sanskrit: tvāṁ vā̱jī ha̍vate vājine̱yo ma̱ho vāja̍sya̱ gadhya̍sya sā̱tau | tvāṁ vṛ̱treṣv i̍ndra̱ satpa̍ti̱ṁ taru̍tra̱ṁ tvāṁ ca̍ṣṭe muṣṭi̱hā goṣu̱ yudhya̍n ||
english: The prize-winner who is the son of the prize calls you for the winning of the great coveted prize; in battles against Vṛtra foes, O Indra, the true master, the conqueror — the fist-striker who fights for cattle looks to you.

sanskrit: tvaṁ ka̱viṁ co̍dayo̱ 'rkasā̍tau̱ tvaṁ kutsā̍ya̱ śuṣṇa̍ṁ dā̱śuṣe̍ vark | tvaṁ śiro̍ ama̱rmaṇa̱ḥ parā̍hann atithi̱gvāya̱ śaṁsya̍ṁ kari̱ṣyan ||
english: You urged on the seer Kavi in the contest of song; you handed over Śuṣṇa to Kutsa for the devoted one; you cut off the head of the invulnerable one, intending to do the praiseworthy deed for Atithigva.

sanskrit: tvaṁ ratha̱m pra bha̍ro yo̱dham ṛ̱ṣvam āvo̱ yudhya̍ntaṁ vṛṣa̱bhaṁ daśa̍dyum | tvaṁ tugra̍ṁ veta̱save̱ sacā̍ha̱n tvaṁ tuji̍ṁ gṛ̱ṇanta̍m indra tūtoḥ ||
english: You drove forward the chariot and aided the lofty fighter, the bull Daśadyu who was fighting; you aided Tugra together with Vetasū; you favored Tuji, O Indra, when he was singing praises.

sanskrit: tvaṁ tad u̱ktham i̍ndra ba̱rhaṇā̍ ka̱ḥ pra yac cha̱tā sa̱hasrā̍ śūra̱ darṣi̍ | ava̍ gi̱rer dāsa̱ṁ śamba̍raṁ ha̱n prāvo̱ divo̍dāsaṁ ci̱trābhi̍r ū̱tī ||
english: You made that hymn great, O Indra, since you burst forth with hundreds and thousands, O hero; you struck down the Dāsa Śambara from the mountain, you helped Divodāsa with your marvelous aids.

sanskrit: tvaṁ śra̱ddhābhi̍r mandasā̱naḥ somai̍r da̱bhīta̍ye̱ cumu̍rim indra siṣvap | tvaṁ ra̱jim piṭhī̍nase daśa̱syan ṣa̱ṣṭiṁ sa̱hasrā̱ śacyā̱ sacā̍han ||
english: You, O Indra, gladdened by the soma-offerings given with faith, lulled Cumuṛī to sleep for Dabhīti; you honored Raji with Piṭhīnasa, and with your might you struck down sixty thousands together.

sanskrit: a̱haṁ ca̱na tat sū̱ribhi̍r ānaśyā̱ṁ tava̱ jyāya̍ indra su̱mnam oja̍ḥ | tvayā̱ yat stava̍nte sadhavīra vī̱rās tri̱varū̍thena̱ nahu̍ṣā śaviṣṭha ||
english: I myself, with patrons, have not yet attained to your highest grace, O Indra, the strength of your favor; when heroes together with heroes praise you, O strongest one, with Nahuṣa's triple shelter.

sanskrit: va̱yaṁ te̍ a̱syām i̍ndra dyu̱mnahū̍tau̱ sakhā̍yaḥ syāma mahina̱ preṣṭhā̍ḥ | prāta̍rdaniḥ kṣatra̱śrīr a̍stu̱ śreṣṭho̍ gha̱ne vṛ̱trāṇā̍ṁ sa̱naye̱ dhanā̍nām ||
english: May we be your most beloved companions, O Indra, at this your call to glory; may the morning-striker, rich in ruling splendor, be the best in the slaying of Vṛtras and the winning of prizes.

sanskrit: kim a̍sya̱ made̱ kim v a̍sya pī̱tāv indra̱ḥ kim a̍sya sa̱khye ca̍kāra | raṇā̍ vā̱ ye ni̱ṣadi̱ kiṁ te a̍sya pu̱rā vi̍vidre̱ kim u̱ nūta̍nāsaḥ ||
english: What has Indra done in his exhilaration by this? What in drinking of this? What in friendship with this? Or those warriors who are seated at rest — what have earlier ones found of his? And what those of recent times?

sanskrit: sad a̍sya̱ made̱ sad v a̍sya pī̱tāv indra̱ḥ sad a̍sya sa̱khye ca̍kāra | raṇā̍ vā̱ ye ni̱ṣadi̱ sat te a̍sya pu̱rā vi̍vidre̱ sad u̱ nūta̍nāsaḥ ||
english: In truth Indra has done something in his exhilaration by this; in truth in drinking of this; in truth in friendship with this; the warriors who are seated at rest — in truth earlier ones have found what is his; and in truth those of recent times too.

sanskrit: na̱hi nu te̍ mahi̱mana̍ḥ samasya̱ na ma̍ghavan maghava̱ttvasya̍ vi̱dma | na rādha̍so-rādhaso̱ nūta̍na̱syendra̱ naki̍r dadṛśa indri̱yaṁ te̍ ||
english: Truly we do not know the measure of your greatness together, O Maghavan, nor of your bountifulness; no one has ever seen, O Indra, your every gift after gift anew, your power.

sanskrit: e̱tat tyat ta̍ indri̱yam a̍ceti̱ yenāva̍dhīr va̱raśi̍khasya̱ śeṣa̍ḥ | vajra̍sya̱ yat te̱ niha̍tasya̱ śuṣmā̍t sva̱nāc ci̍d indra para̱mo da̱dāra̍ ||
english: This power of yours was perceived — that by which you slew the descendant of Varaśikha; from the roaring of your thunderbolt as it struck home, O Indra, even the highest heaven split apart.

sanskrit: vadhī̱d indro̍ va̱raśi̍khasya̱ śeṣo̍ 'bhyāva̱rtine̍ cāyamā̱nāya̱ śikṣa̍n | vṛ̱cīva̍to̱ yad dha̍riyū̱pīyā̍yā̱ṁ han pūrve̱ ardhe̍ bhi̱yasāpa̍ro̱ dart ||
english: Indra slew the descendant of Varaśikha, granting aid to Abhyāvartī Cāyamāna; when he struck down the Vṛcīvant in the battle of Hariyūpīyā, in the forefront the rear side split asunder in fear.

sanskrit: tri̱ṁśaccha̍taṁ va̱rmiṇa̍ indra sā̱kaṁ ya̱vyāva̍tyām puruhūta śrava̱syā | vṛ̱cīva̍nta̱ḥ śara̍ve̱ patya̍mānā̱ḥ pātrā̍ bhindā̱nā nya̱rthāny ā̍yan ||
english: Thirty hundred armored warriors all together, O Indra, on the Yavyāvatī, O much-invoked one, seeking fame — the Vṛcīvants, being struck by arrows, came shattering their vessels, falling one after another.

sanskrit: yasya̱ gāvā̍v aru̱ṣā sū̍yava̱syū a̱ntar ū̱ ṣu cara̍to̱ reri̍hāṇā | sa sṛñja̍yāya tu̱rvaśa̱m parā̍dād vṛ̱cīva̍to daivavā̱tāya̱ śikṣa̍n ||
english: He whose two reddish cows that desire good pasture wander in between, licking each other — he surrendered Turvaśa to the Sṛñjayas, granting help to Daivavāta against the Vṛcīvants.

sanskrit: dva̱yām̐ a̍gne ra̱thino̍ viṁśa̱tiṁ gā va̱dhūma̍to ma̱ghavā̱ mahya̍ṁ sa̱mrāṭ | a̱bhyā̱va̱rtī cā̍yamā̱no da̍dāti dū̱ṇāśe̱yaṁ dakṣi̍ṇā pārtha̱vānā̍m ||
english: Two times twenty cows along with charioteers, along with a groom's party — the Maghavan sovereign gives to me; Abhyāvartī Cāyamāna gives this unstinting sacrificial gift of the Pārthava chieftains.

sanskrit: ā gāvo̍ agmann u̱ta bha̱dram a̍kra̱n sīda̍ntu go̱ṣṭhe ra̱ṇaya̍ntv a̱sme | pra̱jāva̍tīḥ puru̱rūpā̍ i̱ha syu̱r indrā̍ya pū̱rvīr u̱ṣaso̱ duhā̍nāḥ ||
english: The cows have come and they have brought good fortune; may they sit in the cow-stall and be joyful among us; may the many-formed ones rich in offspring be here, milking themselves out through many dawns for Indra.

sanskrit: indro̱ yajva̍ne pṛṇa̱te ca̍ śikṣa̱ty uped da̍dāti̱ na svam mu̍ṣāyati | bhūyo̍-bhūyo ra̱yim id a̍sya va̱rdhaya̱nn abhi̍nne khi̱lye ni da̍dhāti deva̱yum ||
english: Indra gives generously to the sacrificer and the giver, adding gifts on top; he does not rob his own; ever and again increasing his wealth, he establishes the pious man on unbroken fertile ground.

sanskrit: na tā na̍śanti̱ na da̍bhāti̱ taska̍ro̱ nāsā̍m āmi̱tro vyathi̱r ā da̍dharṣati | de̱vām̐ś ca̱ yābhi̱r yaja̍te̱ dadā̍ti ca̱ jyog it tābhi̍ḥ sacate̱ gopa̍tiḥ sa̱ha ||
english: They are not lost; no thief harms them; no hostile unsettlement attacks them; with those cows with which the worshipper sacrifices and gives, the lord of cattle stays with them for a long time.

sanskrit: na tā arvā̍ re̱ṇuka̍kāṭo aśnute̱ na sa̍ṁskṛta̱tram upa̍ yanti̱ tā a̱bhi | u̱ru̱gā̱yam abha̍ya̱ṁ tasya̱ tā anu̱ gāvo̱ marta̍sya̱ vi ca̍ranti̱ yajva̍naḥ ||
english: The rolling warhorse does not reach them; they do not go near the slaughterhouse; the cows of the mortal who sacrifices roam freely in wide, fearless pasture following him.

sanskrit: gāvo̱ bhago̱ gāva̱ indro̍ me acchā̱n gāva̱ḥ soma̍sya pratha̱masya̍ bha̱kṣaḥ | i̱mā yā gāva̱ḥ sa ja̍nāsa̱ indra̍ i̱cchāmīd dhṛ̱dā mana̍sā ci̱d indra̍m ||
english: Cows are fortune, cows are Indra — they have come to me; cows are the first share of soma; these cows, O people — that is Indra; with heart and mind I truly seek Indra.

sanskrit: yū̱yaṁ gā̍vo medayathā kṛ̱śaṁ ci̍d aśrī̱raṁ ci̍t kṛṇuthā su̱pratī̍kam | bha̱draṁ gṛ̱haṁ kṛ̍ṇutha bhadravāco bṛ̱had vo̱ vaya̍ ucyate sa̱bhāsu̍ ||
english: You cows fatten even the thin; you make even the ugly beautiful in appearance; you make the house blessed, O you of blessed voice — your might is proclaimed as great in the assemblies.

sanskrit: pra̱jāva̍tīḥ sū̱yava̍saṁ ri̱śantī̍ḥ śu̱ddhā a̱paḥ su̍prapā̱ṇe piba̍ntīḥ | mā va̍ḥ ste̱na ī̍śata̱ māghaśa̍ṁsa̱ḥ pari̍ vo he̱tī ru̱drasya̍ vṛjyāḥ ||
english: Rich in offspring, grazing on good pasture, drinking pure water at a good watering-place — may no thief rule over you, may no evil-speaking man, may the dart of Rudra pass around you.

sanskrit: upe̱dam u̍pa̱parca̍nam ā̱su goṣūpa̍ pṛcyatām | upa̍ ṛṣa̱bhasya̱ reta̱sy upe̍ndra̱ tava̍ vī̱rye̍ ||
english: May this supplement, this mixing-in, be added to these cows; may it be mixed into the seed of the bull; may it be added, O Indra, to your heroic power.

sanskrit: indra̍ṁ vo̱ nara̍ḥ sa̱khyāya̍ sepur ma̱ho yanta̍ḥ suma̱taye̍ cakā̱nāḥ | ma̱ho hi dā̱tā vajra̍hasto̱ asti̍ ma̱hām u̍ ra̱ṇvam ava̍se yajadhvam ||
english: O men, you have adorned Indra for friendship, striving toward the great one, desirous of his good grace; for the thunderbolt-handed one is a great giver — sacrifice to the great and joyful one for protection.

sanskrit: ā yasmi̱n haste̱ naryā̍ mimi̱kṣur ā rathe̍ hira̱ṇyaye̍ rathe̱ṣṭhāḥ | ā ra̱śmayo̱ gabha̍styoḥ sthū̱rayo̱r ādhva̱nn aśvā̍so̱ vṛṣa̍ṇo yujā̱nāḥ ||
english: In whose hand the manly ones have poured the soma drink, who stands in his golden chariot; the reins have been placed in his two massive fists, and the virile horses have been yoked.

sanskrit: śri̱ye te̱ pādā̱ duva̍ ā mi̍mikṣur dhṛ̱ṣṇur va̱jrī śava̍sā̱ dakṣi̍ṇāvān | vasā̍no̱ atka̍ṁ sura̱bhiṁ dṛ̱śe kaṁ sva1̱̍r ṇa nṛ̍tav iṣi̱ro ba̍bhūtha ||
english: For your glory, your feet have been worshipped and honored; bold one, thunderbolt-bearing, strong in power with your right hand; wearing a fragrant garment, beautiful to see — like the sun, lively, you have become fit for dancing.

sanskrit: sa soma̱ āmi̍ślatamaḥ su̱to bhū̱d yasmi̍n pa̱ktiḥ pa̱cyate̱ santi̍ dhā̱nāḥ | indra̱ṁ nara̍ḥ stu̱vanto̍ brahmakā̱rā u̱kthā śaṁsa̍nto de̱vavā̍tatamāḥ ||
english: May the soma be the most blended and pressed in which the cooking is cooked and the grains are present; the men praising Indra who perform sacred acts, the most beloved of the gods, reciting hymns.

sanskrit: na te̱ anta̱ḥ śava̍so dhāyy a̱sya vi tu bā̍badhe̱ roda̍sī mahi̱tvā | ā tā sū̱riḥ pṛ̍ṇati̱ tūtu̍jāno yū̱thevā̱psu sa̱mīja̍māna ū̱tī ||
english: No limit has been set to the end of this your strength; it has pressed the two worlds apart with its greatness; the patron, eager, fills them as if a herd in the waters, with your aid as it spreads.

sanskrit: e̱ved indra̍ḥ su̱hava̍ ṛ̱ṣvo a̍stū̱tī anū̍tī hiriśi̱praḥ satvā̍ | e̱vā hi jā̱to asa̍mātyojāḥ pu̱rū ca̍ vṛ̱trā ha̍nati̱ ni dasyū̍n ||
english: Thus may Indra be easy to invoke, lofty, praised and re-praised, ruddy-lipped, a warrior; for being born thus of incomparable strength, he slays many Vṛtras and beats down the Dasyus.

sanskrit: bhūya̱ id vā̍vṛdhe vī̱ryā̍ya̱m̐ eko̍ aju̱ryo da̍yate̱ vasū̍ni | pra ri̍rice di̱va indra̍ḥ pṛthi̱vyā a̱rdham id a̍sya̱ prati̱ roda̍sī u̱bhe ||
english: He has grown even more for heroic might, the lone ageless one who apportions goods; Indra has surpassed heaven and earth — both worlds are but half of him.

sanskrit: adhā̍ manye bṛ̱had a̍su̱rya̍m asya̱ yāni̍ dā̱dhāra̱ naki̱r ā mi̍nāti | di̱ve-di̍ve̱ sūryo̍ darśa̱to bhū̱d vi sadmā̍ny urvi̱yā su̱kratu̍r dhāt ||
english: Therefore I think his lordly power great — what he upholds none can diminish; day by day the sun becomes visible; the wise one widely spreads the dwellings.

sanskrit: a̱dyā ci̱n nū ci̱t tad apo̍ na̱dīnā̱ṁ yad ā̍bhyo̱ ara̍do gā̱tum i̍ndra | ni parva̍tā adma̱sado̱ na se̍du̱s tvayā̍ dṛ̱ḻhāni̍ sukrato̱ rajā̍ṁsi ||
english: Even today, even now — that act of giving a path to the rivers' waters, O Indra — the mountains sank down like guests who sit to eat; the firm realms were made so by you, O wise of purpose.

sanskrit: sa̱tyam it tan na tvāvā̍m̐ a̱nyo a̱stīndra̍ de̱vo na martyo̱ jyāyā̍n | aha̱nn ahi̍m pari̱śayā̍na̱m arṇo 'vā̍sṛjo a̱po acchā̍ samu̱dram ||
english: Truly there is no other like you, O Indra — no god, no mortal is greater; you slew the serpent lying around the flood, you released the waters toward the ocean.

sanskrit: tvam a̱po vi duro̱ viṣū̍cī̱r indra̍ dṛ̱ḻham a̍ruja̱ḥ parva̍tasya | rājā̍bhavo̱ jaga̍taś carṣaṇī̱nāṁ sā̱kaṁ sūrya̍ṁ ja̱naya̱n dyām u̱ṣāsa̍m ||
english: You, O Indra, burst open wide the gates of the waters; you broke the firm rock of the mountain; you became king of the moving world and the peoples, bringing forth the sun and the sky and the dawn together.

sanskrit: abhū̱r eko̍ rayipate rayī̱ṇām ā hasta̍yor adhithā indra kṛ̱ṣṭīḥ | vi to̱ke a̱psu tana̍ye ca̱ sūre 'vo̍canta carṣa̱ṇayo̱ vivā̍caḥ ||
english: You became the sole lord of all riches and placed the peoples in your two hands, O Indra; on behalf of offspring, of water, of the sun, of progeny the peoples of various voices have spoken out.

sanskrit: tvad bhi̱yendra̱ pārthi̍vāni̱ viśvācyu̍tā cic cyāvayante̱ rajā̍ṁsi | dyāvā̱kṣāmā̱ parva̍tāso̱ vanā̍ni̱ viśva̍ṁ dṛ̱ḻham bha̍yate̱ ajma̱nn ā te̍ ||
english: From fear of you, O Indra, even the unmoved earthly realms are set in motion; heaven, earth, the mountains and the forests — everything firm trembles at your advance.

sanskrit: tvaṁ kutse̍nā̱bhi śuṣṇa̍m indrā̱śuṣa̍ṁ yudhya̱ kuya̍va̱ṁ gavi̍ṣṭau | daśa̍ prapi̱tve adha̱ sūrya̍sya muṣā̱yaś ca̱kram avi̍ve̱ rapā̍ṁsi ||
english: Together with Kutsa, O Indra, you fought against Śuṣṇa the non-nourishing, the bad harvest-grower, in the struggle for cows; as the sun was turning, you whirled the wheel and covered the mischiefs.

sanskrit: tvaṁ śa̱tāny ava̱ śamba̍rasya̱ puro̍ jaghanthāpra̱tīni̱ dasyo̍ḥ | aśi̍kṣo̱ yatra̱ śacyā̍ śacīvo̱ divo̍dāsāya sunva̱te su̍takre bha̱radvā̍jāya gṛṇa̱te vasū̍ni ||
english: You struck down the hundreds of Śambara's strongholds, unyielding, those of the Dasyu; there, O powerful one, with your might you bestowed goods on Divodāsa who presses soma, on Bharadvāja who sings praises.

sanskrit: sa sa̍tyasatvan maha̱te raṇā̍ya̱ ratha̱m ā ti̍ṣṭha tuvinṛmṇa bhī̱mam | yā̱hi pra̍pathi̱nn ava̱sopa̍ ma̱drik pra ca̍ śruta śrāvaya carṣa̱ṇibhya̍ḥ ||
english: O hero of true valor, of great strength, mount your fearsome chariot for the great battle; go, O you who make the path ready, with protection come, O Madrik; and having been praised, make yourself heard among the peoples.

sanskrit: apū̍rvyā puru̱tamā̍ny asmai ma̱he vī̱rāya̍ ta̱vase̍ tu̱rāya̍ | vi̱ra̱pśine̍ va̱jriṇe̱ śaṁta̍māni̱ vacā̍ṁsy ā̱sā sthavi̍rāya takṣam ||
english: Unprecedented and most numerous words for him — for the great hero, the powerful and swift, the mighty one, the thunderbolt-bearer — I have fashioned with my mouth the most blissful praises for the firm one.

sanskrit: sa mā̱tarā̱ sūrye̍ṇā kavī̱nām avā̍sayad ru̱jad adri̍ṁ gṛṇā̱naḥ | svā̱dhībhi̱r ṛkva̍bhir vāvaśā̱na ud u̱sriyā̍ṇām asṛjan ni̱dāna̍m ||
english: He lit up the two mothers with the sun of the seers, breaking the rock while being praised; with well-aimed, hymn-singing, roaring ones he released the fetters of the dawn-cows.

sanskrit: sa vahni̍bhi̱r ṛkva̍bhi̱r goṣu̱ śaśva̍n mi̱tajñu̍bhiḥ puru̱kṛtvā̍ jigāya | pura̍ḥ puro̱hā sakhi̍bhiḥ sakhī̱yan dṛ̱ḻhā ru̍roja ka̱vibhi̍ḥ ka̱viḥ san ||
english: With singing fire-bearers he ever wins the cattle, with agile-kneed ones, the great doer; leading the vanguard, being a friend among friends, he broke the firm ones, being a seer among seers.

sanskrit: sa nī̱vyā̍bhir jari̱tāra̱m acchā̍ ma̱ho vāje̍bhir ma̱hadbhi̍ś ca̱ śuṣmai̍ḥ | pu̱ru̱vīrā̍bhir vṛṣabha kṣitī̱nām ā gi̍rvaṇaḥ suvi̱tāya̱ pra yā̍hi ||
english: With your battle-arrays come toward the singer, with great prizes and great strength; with those rich in heroes, O bull of the peoples, come, O lover of praises, for our good fortune.

sanskrit: sa sarge̍ṇa̱ śava̍sā ta̱kto atyai̍r a̱pa indro̍ dakṣiṇa̱tas tu̍rā̱ṣāṭ | i̱tthā sṛ̍jā̱nā ana̍pāvṛ̱d artha̍ṁ di̱ve-di̍ve viviṣur apramṛ̱ṣyam ||
english: Indra, impelled with a stream of power, conquering swiftly with his charges on the right, releasing them thus, he does not turn away from his goal; day by day they strive for the imperishable.

sanskrit: ya oji̍ṣṭha indra̱ taṁ su no̍ dā̱ mado̍ vṛṣan svabhi̱ṣṭir dāsvā̍n | sauva̍śvya̱ṁ yo va̱nava̱t svaśvo̍ vṛ̱trā sa̱matsu̍ sā̱saha̍d a̱mitrā̍n ||
english: O Indra, give us that most powerful exhilaration, O bull, with your own protection, O giver; you who are well-horsed will win wealth of good horses and conquer Vṛtras and enemies in battles.

sanskrit: tvāṁ hī̱ndrāva̍se̱ vivā̍co̱ hava̍nte carṣa̱ṇaya̱ḥ śūra̍sātau | tvaṁ vipre̍bhi̱r vi pa̱ṇīm̐r a̍śāya̱s tvota̱ it sani̍tā̱ vāja̱m arvā̍ ||
english: Indeed you, O Indra, the peoples call out to in many voices for protection in the winning of heroes; with the seers you have dispersed the Paṇis — only aided by you does the steed win the prize.

sanskrit: tvaṁ tām̐ i̍ndro̱bhayā̍m̐ a̱mitrā̱n dāsā̍ vṛ̱trāṇy āryā̍ ca śūra | vadhī̱r vane̍va̱ sudhi̍tebhi̱r atkai̱r ā pṛ̱tsu da̍rṣi nṛ̱ṇāṁ nṛ̍tama ||
english: You, O Indra, have slain those two kinds of enemies — both the Dāsa Vṛtras and the Ārya ones, O hero; like trees in the forest with well-sharpened blades, you tear them apart in battles, O most manly of men.

sanskrit: sa tvaṁ na̍ i̱ndrāka̍vābhir ū̱tī sakhā̍ vi̱śvāyu̍r avi̱tā vṛ̱dhe bhū̍ḥ | sva̍rṣātā̱ yad dhvayā̍masi tvā̱ yudhya̍nto ne̱madhi̍tā pṛ̱tsu śū̍ra ||
english: Be you that one, O Indra, with your keen aids, our friend, protector for all time, for our increase; as we call you fighting for the winning of heaven, without stumbling, O hero, in the battles.

sanskrit: nū̱naṁ na̍ indrāpa̱rāya̍ ca syā̱ bhavā̍ mṛḻī̱ka u̱ta no̍ a̱bhiṣṭau̍ | i̱tthā gṛ̱ṇanto̍ ma̱hina̍sya̱ śarma̍n di̱vi ṣyā̱ma pārye̍ go̱ṣata̍māḥ ||
english: Now, O Indra, and hereafter, be our benefactor, our aid in our attack; praising you thus, may we dwell in the shelter of the great one, in the highest heaven, most rich in cattle.

sanskrit: saṁ ca̱ tve ja̱gmur gira̍ indra pū̱rvīr vi ca̱ tvad ya̍nti vi̱bhvo̍ manī̱ṣāḥ | pu̱rā nū̱naṁ ca̍ stu̱taya̱ ṛṣī̍ṇām paspṛ̱dhra indre̱ adhy u̍kthā̱rkā ||
english: Many praises have converged upon you, O Indra, and from you the abundant inspirations go forth; both of old and now the praises of seers have contended with each other — songs and hymns in Indra's presence.

sanskrit: pu̱ru̱hū̱to yaḥ pu̍rugū̱rta ṛbhvā̱m̐ eka̍ḥ purupraśa̱sto asti̍ ya̱jñaiḥ | ratho̱ na ma̱he śava̍se yujā̱no̱ 'smābhi̱r indro̍ anu̱mādyo̍ bhūt ||
english: He who is much-invoked, much-praised, most skillful, alone most celebrated through sacrifices — like a chariot yoked for great power, may Indra be our object of joy.

sanskrit: na yaṁ hiṁsa̍nti dhī̱tayo̱ na vāṇī̱r indra̱ṁ nakṣa̱ntīd a̱bhi va̱rdhaya̍ntīḥ | yadi̍ sto̱tāra̍ḥ śa̱taṁ yat sa̱hasra̍ṁ gṛ̱ṇanti̱ girva̍ṇasa̱ṁ śaṁ tad a̍smai ||
english: Prayers and songs do not harm him — reaching Indra they only increase him; whether the praisers are a hundred or a thousand singing to him who loves praises, that is a blessing to him.

sanskrit: asmā̍ e̱tad di̱vy a̱rceva̍ mā̱sā mi̍mi̱kṣa indre̱ ny a̍yāmi̱ soma̍ḥ | jana̱ṁ na dhanva̍nn a̱bhi saṁ yad āpa̍ḥ sa̱trā vā̍vṛdhu̱r hava̍nāni ya̱jñaiḥ ||
english: For him, like months in the sky like stars, the soma is poured down into Indra; like water over a parched people when it comes — the invocations and sacrifices have all increased together.

sanskrit: asmā̍ e̱tan mahy ā̍ṅgū̱ṣam a̍smā̱ indrā̍ya sto̱tram ma̱tibhi̍r avāci | asa̱d yathā̍ maha̱ti vṛ̍tra̱tūrya̱ indro̍ vi̱śvāyu̍r avi̱tā vṛ̱dhaś ca̍ ||
english: This great song of praise, this hymn, was spoken for him — for Indra — with devotional thoughts; may Indra, ageless and great, be our helper and increaser in the great ordeal of conquering Vṛtra.

sanskrit: ka̱dā bhu̍va̱n ratha̍kṣayāṇi̱ brahma̍ ka̱dā sto̱tre sa̍hasrapo̱ṣya̍ṁ dāḥ | ka̱dā stoma̍ṁ vāsayo 'sya rā̱yā ka̱dā dhiya̍ḥ karasi̱ vāja̍ratnāḥ ||
english: When will there be chariot-wealth, O Brahman? When will you give the praiser a thousand head of cattle? When will you clothe our hymn of praise in wealth? When will you make our prayers gems of the prize?

sanskrit: karhi̍ svi̱t tad i̍ndra̱ yan nṛbhi̱r nṝn vī̱rair vī̱rān nī̱ḻayā̍se̱ jayā̱jīn | tri̱dhātu̱ gā adhi̍ jayāsi̱ goṣv indra̍ dyu̱mnaṁ sva̍rvad dhehy a̱sme ||
english: When, O Indra, will you with men press down men, with heroes press heroes, winning battles? When will you conquer cows of the threefold foundation? O Indra, place in us glory rich in heaven's light.

sanskrit: karhi̍ svi̱t tad i̍ndra̱ yaj ja̍ri̱tre vi̱śvapsu̱ brahma̍ kṛ̱ṇava̍ḥ śaviṣṭha | ka̱dā dhiyo̱ na ni̱yuto̍ yuvāse ka̱dā goma̍ghā̱ hava̍nāni gacchāḥ ||
english: When, O Indra, will you make the prayer all-nourishing for the singer, O most powerful? When will you yoke inspirations like teams of horses? When will you come, rich in cattle, to our invocations?

sanskrit: sa goma̍ghā jari̱tre aśva̍ścandrā̱ vāja̍śravaso̱ adhi̍ dhehi̱ pṛkṣa̍ḥ | pī̱pi̱hīṣa̍ḥ su̱dughā̍m indra dhe̱num bha̱radvā̍jeṣu su̱ruco̍ rurucyāḥ ||
english: Place on the singer the supplies rich in cattle and splendid with horses, renowned as prize — O Indra, wishing to fill, cause the well-milking cow to overflow; shine brilliantly among the Bharadvājas.

sanskrit: tam ā nū̱naṁ vṛ̱jana̍m a̱nyathā̍ ci̱c chūro̱ yac cha̍kra̱ vi duro̍ gṛṇī̱ṣe | mā nir a̍raṁ śukra̱dugha̍sya dhe̱nor ā̍ṅgira̱sān brahma̍ṇā vipra jinva ||
english: Him now, a community otherwise, when you can, O hero, O mighty one, praise opening the doors; let me not fail the brightly-milking cow — O wise one, quicken the Āṅgirasas with prayer.

sanskrit: sa̱trā madā̍sa̱s tava̍ vi̱śvaja̍nyāḥ sa̱trā rāyo 'dha̱ ye pārthi̍vāsaḥ | sa̱trā vājā̍nām abhavo vibha̱ktā yad de̱veṣu̍ dhā̱raya̍thā asu̱rya̍m ||
english: Yours are the exhilarations for all peoples together, yours are the riches including those of the earth; you became the distributor of all prizes together when you held the lordship among the gods.

sanskrit: anu̱ pra ye̍je̱ jana̱ ojo̍ asya sa̱trā da̍dhire̱ anu̍ vī̱ryā̍ya | syū̱ma̱gṛbhe̱ dudha̱ye 'rva̍te ca̱ kratu̍ṁ vṛñja̱nty api̍ vṛtra̱hatye̍ ||
english: The peoples have followed his strength in succession, they have taken on all of it together for heroic power; for him who grasps the rein and the hard-running steed they pursue resolution in the Vṛtra-slaying.

sanskrit: taṁ sa̱dhrīcī̍r ū̱tayo̱ vṛṣṇyā̍ni̱ pauṁsyā̍ni ni̱yuta̍ḥ saścu̱r indra̍m | sa̱mu̱draṁ na sindha̍va u̱kthaśu̍ṣmā uru̱vyaca̍sa̱ṁ gira̱ ā vi̍śanti ||
english: The aids, the virile powers, the manly strengths — all together they followed Indra with their teams; like rivers into the ocean, the hymns powerful in sound enter the wide-abiding one.

sanskrit: sa rā̱yas khām upa̍ sṛjā gṛṇā̱naḥ pu̍ruśca̱ndrasya̱ tvam i̍ndra̱ vasva̍ḥ | pati̍r babhū̱thāsa̍mo̱ janā̍nā̱m eko̱ viśva̍sya̱ bhuva̍nasya̱ rājā̍ ||
english: Being praised, release toward us the wellspring of wealth of manifold splendor, O Indra; you have become the incomparable lord of the peoples, the sole king of the entire world.

sanskrit: sa tu śru̍dhi̱ śrutyā̱ yo du̍vo̱yur dyaur na bhūmā̱bhi rāyo̍ a̱ryaḥ ||aso̱ yathā̍ na̱ḥ śava̍sā cakā̱no yu̱ge-yu̍ge̱ vaya̍sā̱ ceki̍tānaḥ ||
english: Hear, O praiseworthy one, you who are eager for worship — the noble one who covers riches like heaven over earth — be one who is glad toward us with his strength, who is wise with power in age after age.

sanskrit: a̱rvāg ratha̍ṁ vi̱śvavā̍raṁ ta u̱grendra̍ yu̱ktāso̱ hara̍yo vahantu | kī̱riś ci̱d dhi tvā̱ hava̍te̱ sva̍rvān ṛdhī̱mahi̍ sadha̱māda̍s te a̱dya ||
english: Let your yoked bay horses carry hither your chariot full of all treasures, O fierce Indra; for even the singer who wins the sun calls you — may we prosper as your co-rejoicers today.

sanskrit: pro droṇe̱ hara̍ya̱ḥ karmā̍gman punā̱nāsa̱ ṛjya̍nto abhūvan | indro̍ no a̱sya pū̱rvyaḥ pa̍pīyād dyu̱kṣo mada̍sya so̱myasya̱ rājā̍ ||
english: The bay horses have come forward to the trough in their work, being purified, having become upright; may Indra, our ancient one, drink of this soma — the sky-dwelling king of the soma exhilaration.

sanskrit: ā̱sa̱srā̱ṇāsa̍ḥ śavasā̱nam acchendra̍ṁ suca̱kre ra̱thyā̍so̱ aśvā̍ḥ | a̱bhi śrava̱ ṛjya̍nto vaheyu̱r nū ci̱n nu vā̱yor a̱mṛta̱ṁ vi da̍syet ||
english: The chariot-horses, flowing forth, have beautified the wheel toward Indra rich in strength; may they, going straight, carry him to glory; surely even now Vāyu's immortal portion would not fail.

sanskrit: vari̍ṣṭho asya̱ dakṣi̍ṇām iya̱rtīndro̍ ma̱ghonā̍ṁ tuvikū̱rmita̍maḥ | yayā̍ vajrivaḥ pari̱yāsy aṁho̍ ma̱ghā ca̍ dhṛṣṇo̱ daya̍se̱ vi sū̱rīn ||
english: The most distinguished one stirs up his right hand — Indra, most active with power among the bountiful; by which you, O thunderbolt-bearer, pass beyond straits, and O bold one, you distribute gifts, dividing among the patrons.

sanskrit: indro̱ vāja̍sya̱ sthavi̍rasya dā̱tendro̍ gī̱rbhir va̍rdhatāṁ vṛ̱ddhama̍hāḥ | indro̍ vṛ̱traṁ hani̍ṣṭho astu̱ satvā tā sū̱riḥ pṛ̍ṇati̱ tūtu̍jānaḥ ||
english: Indra is the giver of firm and solid prizes; may Indra grow in greatness through hymns; may Indra as warrior be the best slayer of Vṛtra — the patron, eager, fills both of those.
